description: 60 public registered tourist homes and rural lodgings; two queries per street address. Registry reference data, not independently surveyed coordinates or a national sample. Floor, unit, owner and contact fields excluded.

selection: First distinct streets in register-id order among first 1000 active homes per Catalan province (8 Barcelona, 8 Girona, 7 Lleida, 7 Tarragona); first distinct localities with simple numbered street addresses among first 100 rural records per Castilian-Leonese province (4 Ávila/Burgos/León, 3 each remaining province). Excludes road kilometre addresses, number ranges, missing postcodes and repeated Calle Calle. No provider results influenced selection.
